THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE THESE FACTS ARE AUTHORED: landed slices + their landing SHAs, the SCHEMA version, the next slice, the remaining ladder, AC status, and the ruled/unruled decision set. Regenerate with `scripts/check-release-state-views.sh --write`. TO CHANGE A FACT: edit it HERE, then run --write, then commit both. Do NOT hand-edit inside the markers. SCOPE: this file records state, it does not decide anything - it changes no release slot, no scope, no requirement and no AC. publish_gate._model: THREE DISTINCT FACTS, deliberately NOT collapsed into one word. The predecessor model carried `minted`/`signed` plus a single `state_word: "unsigned"`, and the STATUS §1 `Unblocks` view rendered its sentence off that one word — so the board told every reader `**Publish remains blocked on AC-079**, which is **still unsigned**` AFTER the HITL had PRE-SIGNED that delta on 2026-07-25 (master F-34). Restating a settled call as still open is precisely how a settled call gets re-decided. The three facts a consumer MUST read separately: (1) `pre_sign_state` - has the HITL signed off on the CONTENT of the delta yet? (2) `minted` + `sign_off_slice` - has the AC been minted into dev/acceptance.md and recorded there as SIGNED yet? PRE-SIGN IS NOT MINTING. (3) `publish_gated_by` - what actually holds publish, which is the separate HITL publish gate (`decisions.unruled` id `publish`), NOT an unsigned AC. No consumer may derive a single status word from `minted`/`signed` alone; both renderers (scripts/check-release-state-views.sh render_status_unblocks, scripts/commission-manifest.sh publish-gate line) branch on `pre_sign_state` and hard-fail on an unrecognised value or a reintroduced `state_word`.

unruled.gated_at: After Slice 40. TWO INDEPENDENT GATES, neither sufficient alone: (i) every ci.yml job THAT EXECUTED concludes success on the landed commit, AND (ii) explicit HITL approval. Ruled 2026-07-30 (seq-202); HITL noted it may be relaxed later but stands while the line has gone this long unpublished. No conflict with seq-152 — the ci.yml security job runs agent-security.sh, not a Dependabot scan. ⚠ AMENDED 2026-07-30 (HITL, seq-211): gate (i) originally read 'every ci.yml job concludes success', which is UNMEETABLE BY CONSTRUCTION — the markdownlint job is `if: needs.changes.outputs.docs_only == 'true'` (ci.yml:379), so it is SKIPPED on every non-docs push. Both measured full runs (30546942720, 30550762581) show 23 jobs with exactly 1 skipped, and the skip is markdownlint. The gate therefore keys on jobs that EXECUTED; a skipped job is a distinct third state and is neither a pass nor a failure. This narrows nothing in substance — no executing job may fail. ⚠ MEASURED ON: the ci.yml run of Slice 40's own LANDING commit (HITL 2026-07-30, steward seq-223). No single run executes every job — markdownlint is docs_only-gated and seven code jobs are !docs_only-gated — so a docs-only push yields a partial green that proves nothing about the engine. That is not hypothetical: it is how a ~3-week verify/security red stayed invisible, the most recent 'successful' run having SKIPPED both.

The surrounding sentence is NOT generated, for two reasons, both binding. (1) Its two items are worded in different shapes ('the <label> - <detail>, taken to the HITL **once**, at <gate>' vs '**<label>** (<gate>, hard gate)') and it closes on a findings citation (master F-34), so no template over the fact model reproduces it; only pasting the sentence into this JSON would, and that is the move check-release-state-views.sh explicitly refuses ('widen the fact model or NARROW THE REGION - never paste the prose into the JSON'). (2) CommonMark: a blockquote line whose content BEGINS with `<!--` is an HTML block that swallows the whole line, so a BEGIN marker cannot be placed at the head of this line without changing how it renders. Narrowing keeps the fence in place, byte-exact, and fully reversible. The full ruled/unruled table is emitted by `ledgerwatch <ledger> --project rulings`, and the ruled/unruled FACTS live in `decisions` above; §4's items 1-22 are the historical decision record and are deliberately NOT under generation.
